no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per the FY2025 10-K (filed April 2026), Petros has exited the Stendra (avanafil) ED franchise: in March 2025 the Vivus license was terminated and Vivus foreclosed on Stendra collateral; in June 2025 Petros executed an Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors transferring all subsidiary assets (Metuchen, Timm Medical, Pos-T-Vac) to a third-party assignee. The company is now a shell-like entity attempting to develop a SaaS / Software-as-a-Medical-Device (SaMD) platform to assist Rx-to-OTC switches. Auditor expressed substantial doubt about going concern (USD 5.1M cash, USD 2.9M working capital, USD 111.3M accumulated deficit at 2025-12-31). No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials.
excluded_legacy_terminated: Stendra (avanafil) Rx-to-OTC switch - prior pivotal consumer self-selection study completed; license terminated and asset returned to Vivus in March 2025
